t: This is the site of the Royalty Theatre, at 73 Dean Street in Soho. It was a small theatre, and it closed to the public in 1938. The actress Frances Maria Kelly founded it in 1840 as Miss Kelly's Theatre and Dramatic School. Samuel Beazley designed it. He became the leading theatre architect of his time, and the first notable English expert in that field. The opening was ill-fated, and the theatre was little used for a decade. It later changed its name twice, and hosted an opera company, amateur drama and French pieces.
